title: Tissue Identification
summary: A laparoscopic grasper with force and displacement sensing that recognizes tissue in real time.
body: Given the lack of force feedback available to clinicians performing laparoscopic and robot-assisted surgeries, it is often difficult to determine how much force to apply to a tissue — or even to tell which tissue is in the jaws.

This project produced a laparoscopic grasper instrumented with force and displacement sensors that recognizes tissue in real time and relays that information back to the surgeon. Because measuring force directly at the grasping site is difficult, a parallel effort estimated grip force for da Vinci surgical tools from backend sensors using machine learning methods such as neural networks.
researchers: Trevor Stephens, Rodney Dockter, Astrini Sie, Michael Winek
